events.summary: 阿历克接连数日攻掠各定居点、强登敌舰，都没能找到塔拉辛。
events.quote: Talasyn wasn’t on the front lines at any of the settlements that Alaric stormed through over the next few days.

events.summary: 他从最后一座内陆城市撤返，勉强赶在月食前回到营房，在 In-Between 见到伤痕比上次更多的塔拉辛。
events.quote: After the Valisante retreated from the last inland city on the agenda, Alaric barely made it back to the barracks in time for the eclipse.

events.summary: 塔拉辛当面声明自己并不在 Allfold 一方，阿历克说自己对她一无所知。
events.quote: “You know I’m not with the Allfold,” Talasyn said. Alaric hated how easily she could read his thoughts on his face.

events.summary: 塔拉辛坦白曾视他为怪物，后来看到他待她温柔，后悔当年因恐惧没能抓住那次机会。
events.quote: She blinked as though holding back tears—as though, he realized with a pang, she was afraid that he’d accuse her once again of trying to manipulate him with them. “It will always be my greatest regret.”

events.summary: 阿历克说两人从一开始就是错误，临别叮嘱她提防乌尔杜嘉，塔拉辛留下“你永远拥有我的心”便消失。
events.quote: But there was only a gentle light in Talasyn’s eyes. There was only a trembling softness to her lips. “You hold my heart forever,” she told him, and then she was gone.

events.summary: 塔拉辛在黎明群岛的山顶醒来，见太阳之路峰顶被七根巨大岩柱围成一圈。
events.quote: The summit of the Path of the Sun was encircled within seven rock pillars—although she wasn’t even sure if pillar was the correct term.

events.summary: 地震中七条巨龙从各自洞穴爬出，一齐向她吐出光织。
events.quote: The dragons shrieked again, beating their wings, lowering their heads from the pillars until Talasyn was surrounded by a ring of open jaws. Then, as one, they breathed out the Lightweave.

events.summary: 她浮空，母亲的幻影现身抱住她，她第一次用涅纳瓦雷语唤出“Inang”。
events.quote: She called out a Nenavarene word that she’d learned but had never before had any occasion to use. “Inang.”

relations.relation: 夫妻（分属敌对阵营，仍彼此牵挂）
relations.quote: That was the moment Alaric realized that something had changed. Somewhere along the line, while he hadn’t been there to bear witness, his wife had changed.

relations.relation: 母女（亡母于幻象中现身相拥）
relations.quote: Hanan Ivralis smiled back and wrapped her arms around her sobbing daughter.

relations.relation: 君臣（扎希亚-拉奇斯与她，彼此猜忌）
relations.quote: What had Alaric meant when he told her to be careful around Urduja? He clearly suspected something, although he had no concrete evidence.

relations.relation: 主从（加赫里斯与军官们约束他的决断）
relations.quote: I saw for myself how your father treated you and how you had genuinely good ideas on meeting people’s needs, but you were constrained by what Gaheris and your officers wanted.

relations.relation: 同盟／告知者（告知她“自己的家人”或已不可及）
relations.quote: Even if Iyaram had said that it might not be within reach anymore, the hope of it would have to sustain Talasyn in the days to come.

numbers.context: 太阳之路峰顶围成圈的岩柱数量
numbers.quote: The summit of the Path of the Sun was encircled within seven rock pillars—although she wasn’t even sure if pillar was the correct term.

numbers.context: 每根岩柱底部的宽度约一英里
numbers.quote: They were enormous, every single one of them almost a mile across.

numbers.context: 除首条外陆续出洞的巨龙数量（共七条）
numbers.quote: It was joined by six others, each one clambering out from its respective cave in eerie unison.

numbers.context: 距下一次月食还要再等几夜
numbers.quote: There wouldn’t be another one for a few more nights.

numbers.context: 她感到仿佛同时经历一千次“光裂”
numbers.quote: It was like stepping into a thousand Light Severs all at once, the sensation that she’d only ever felt on Belian unfolding through her here on the western spine of the world.

numbers.context: 她的灵魂如第八月亮的碎片般明亮锋利
numbers.quote: each facet of her soul as bright and sharp as the shards of the eighth moon.
